format: Aura Seeker (ASK; v174): the Japanese set the English Flowing Fists (FLO) comes from, from PokéBeach's translations. Japanese numbering (1-78). Sigilyph ex 31, Riolu 44 and Mega Lucario Z ex 57 are prints of Flowing Fists' cards. Regulation mark J = Standard.

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Acid Trap
abilities.text: If you have a Stadium in play, once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned and Burned.

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Damage Beat
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Claw
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Assassin Blade
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Stealth Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Evolution Pokémon your opponent has in play.

attacks.name: Continuous Steps
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

abilities.name: Deception
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out, and if you have exactly 5 cards in your hand, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Splatter
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bubble Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Torrential Pump
abilities.text: Attacks used by your Water Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Benched Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). This Ability's effect doesn't stack.

attacks.name: Hot-Blooded Head
attacks.text: You may reveal a Crasher Wake's Fervor from your hand. If you do, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: Guide
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Hustle Screw
attacks.text: Reveal any number of Crasher Wake's Fervor cards from your hand. This attack does 100 more damage for each card revealed in this way. Then, shuffle the revealed cards back into your deck.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Passion Dance
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand and put up to 3 Basic Pokémon you find there onto your opponent's Bench.

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Assault Bolt
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 80 more damage.

abilities.name: Double Strike
abilities.text: This Pokémon may use an attack it has twice. (If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent's Active Pokémon, you may attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Scary Face
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 30 less damage.

abilities.name: Energy Leap
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at your opponent's hand, choose an Energy card you find there, and attach it to 1 of their Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Yoga Power
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Guts Fight
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Bloody Fear
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Stadium cards or attach any Special Energy from their hand.

attacks.name: Welcoming Song
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Sage's Command
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage for each Mega Evolution Pokémon ex on your Bench.

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your or your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Magic Tentacle
attacks.text: Discard the top card of each player's deck, and this attack does 100 more damage for each Trainer card discarded in this way.

abilities.name: Trained Arms
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks aren't affected by Resistance or any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Guts Fight
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Triple Kick
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Guts Fight
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Mountain Munch
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Great Tremor
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play or this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Circle Throw
attacks.text: Switch your opponent's Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. (Your opponent chooses the Pokémon to switch in.)

attacks.name: Guts Fight
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Overflowing Cheer
abilities.text: The Guts Fight attack used by your Pokémon costs Colorless less.

abilities.name: Solidarity Formation
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. For each of your Benched Pokémon that has "Falinks" in its name, search your deck for a Basic Fighting Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Strong Attack
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Wicked Blow
attacks.text: You may discard a Darkness Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 140 more damage.

attacks.name: Torrential Strike
attacks.text: You may discard a Water Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack also does 40 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Skill Control
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Mega Evolution Pokémon ex's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Toxic Gem
attacks.text: Place damage counters on 2 of your opponent's Pokémon until their remaining HP is 60 each.

attacks.name: Great Spin
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Heavy Bomber
attacks.text: This attack does 50 less damage for each Energy in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Big Jaw
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Cavalry Thrust
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your opponent's Basic Pokémon in play.

abilities.name: Dual Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is both Lightning and Metal type.

attacks.name: Full-Power Needle
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Full-Power Needle attack does 60 damage.

attacks.name: Long Drive
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack also does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Burrow and Resupply
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, choose a Basic Metal Energy card from your discard pile and attach it to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Smash Head
attacks.text: Choose 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon and discard them.

abilities.name: Vibrating Wings
abilities.text: If this card is in your hand, you may use this Ability once during your turn. If you do, discard this card. Look at the top card of your deck, then return it.

attacks.name: Desert Wind
attacks.text: You may choose 2 Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon and shuffle them into your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Dragon Avenger
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Dragon Pokémon in your discard pile.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Power Breath
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Dragon Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Latent Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Draw a card.

abilities.name: Large Coin
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have 2 or more Pokémon in play with the "Pay Day" attack, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Greedy Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your hand.

abilities.name: Synchro Body
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it has the same type as all of your Benched Pokémon, in addition to its original type. (If you have Pokémon of 2 or more types, it has each of those types.)

attacks.name: Pounce
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Thudding March
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon with a Retreat Cost of 4, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Destructive Hammer
attacks.text: You may discard up to 10 cards from the top of your deck. This attack does 10 more damage for each card discarded in this way.

cards.name: Bonding Sash
cards.text: If the Mega Evolution Pokémon ex this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Korrina's Seriousness
cards.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

cards.name: Crasher Wake's Fervor
cards.text: Choose 1 of your Water Pokémon in play and shuffle that Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

cards.name: Reporter
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Your opponent reveals their hand. Look at the top card of your opponent's deck, then return it.

cards.name: Fight Arena
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may heal 20 damage from each of their Pokémon (excluding Pokémon with a Rule Box).
